Page 1A Cont.
Thomas Kauffman - 63 - stroke in Georgia on way to Florida Edwd Howley - 6 - Youngstown, O. - helpless.
Page 2
Oct. 27th
6th Cornelius Boes - 35 - and wife homeless ..... M.C. Thanksgiving
27 Titus Denk - 52 - away from wife and duties 5 yrs - Fearfully scandalous ... John Pcuza - 60 - cataracts losing sight.
22 Lavinea Carriere - 5 - Noelville Ontario - crippled leg from birth Frank Schmidt - 53 - Softenin of scul & brain etc.
Mrs. Frances Sills - 42 - Stomic anxious for .... her boys.
Raymond Chatel - 48 - Terribly burned Oct. 3rd - Explosion - prayed for .... Astonishingly well. Thank God
Mrs. Rose Herman - about 35 - in very threatened condition. Husband earnestly asks for prayers.
Page 2 A
Martin McEvoy - 50 - in Ford Hosp - very low - blood poison Esther Michaud - 22 - strep - T.B. - discouraged at times - given up a year ago.
Mrs. Josephine Kenney .... 2 weeks ago had spinal T.B ..... little hopes at that time .... Drs. astonished.
Nov. 1937
1937, November
Lucile Salatka - 9 - Sarcomic Cancer
Arthur Gouche - 5 - could not sit up till -with water-on-brain: - could not even hold his head up. Enrolled and was brought to devo- tions here again and again. Then became quite improved. Last year was taken to St. Ann's Qub ... has been improving of late ... can walk nicely now - speak intelligently ... happy and singing off and on all day. Deo Gr.
